cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've found our wedding video. Shall we watch it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your father's speech. We never could agree what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. Let's skip to the dancing, then. No speeches. You can help me settle whether your uncle actually falls into the cake.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me open it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every evening. There, your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Could you take the price sticker off before I sit?

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.
